what_this_is: The first end-to-end generation ever taken from the sealed GLM-5.2-H0.98-Math-Preserve substrate over HTTP. It is the measurement Odyssey promotion gates G4 and G5 were waiting on, and it did not come out clean.
why_the_controller_ran_it: The delegated lane reported it could not obtain a live completion because Metal devices were invisible to its process (MTLCopyAllDevices count 0). That was a sandbox artifact of the delegated process, not a machine fact. An independent Metal probe from the controller's own process found one device: Apple M3 Ultra, unified memory, maxBufferLength 62,620,631,040, Metal 4. The ioreg recoveryCount of 42 is historical, not current. A report is a claim -- including a report that something is impossible.

the_wire_works.chat_template: the artifact's own tokenizer/chat_template.jinja, not a guessed one
the_wire_works.default_off_preserved: serve without --gravity still errors '--weights is required', so nothing changed for existing users
the_wire_works.significance: before this, crates/hawking-serve contained zero references to gravity and the only executor of the 92 GB artifact was an example binary. The artifact is now reachable over HTTP.

trials.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

the_generation_is_degenerate.the_decisive_observation: Two semantically unrelated prompts produced BYTE-IDENTICAL output. The generation is prompt-independent.
the_generation_is_degenerate.timing_note: 190 s and 143 s for 8 tokens is consistent with the measured BASE_TRUE_TPS of 0.3961 warm plus prefill, on a machine at load ~29 of 28 cores. The timing is contaminated and is not offered as a performance figure. It does establish that real work happened rather than a cached or canned reply.

token_identity.how_derived: read tokenizer.json from the artifact's own tokenizer directory; vocab['9'] == 24
token_identity.why_it_is_informative: The model emitted id 24 eight times regardless of prompt. Contrast the Llama-1B precedent, which collapsed onto ' settle' -- a semantically real token whose neighbours in the oracle top-5 were ' settled' and ' settles', i.e. a genuine if degenerate distribution. A constant low id with no semantic neighbourhood is more consistent with a constant or garbage logit vector than with a collapsed-but-real distribution.
token_identity.what_it_still_does_not_settle: Whether the constant logits originate in the artifact's payload or in a serve path that never conditions on the prompt. The oracle comparison remains the discriminator.

H1_artifact_collapse.claim: Math-Preserve at 0.9774 BPW has collapsed generation, as its lower-BPW siblings did.
H1_artifact_collapse.supporting_prior: HAWKING_MODEL_FEEL_PARITY_RESULTS.json records Llama-3.2-1B at 0.8774 BPW emitting ' settle settle settle ...' and GLM-5.2 General-R0 at 0.8829 BPW failing screening twice, still failing at 0.9211 BPW after lm_head and embed_tokens native protection, with the standing verdict R0_IS_THE_PRACTICAL_CEILING.
H1_artifact_collapse.against: Math-Preserve is a materially different artifact from R0: higher BPW and 67,526,197,248 bytes of protected islands. Its generation quality is recorded in that same file as NOT_MEASURED. R0's failure does not transfer by assumption.

H2_serve_path_does_not_condition.claim: The prompt never reaches the model, so the output is whatever the model emits from an empty or constant context.
H2_serve_path_does_not_condition.supporting: The delegated lane's own report states the gravity path is: admit via encode_prompt_for_batch -> prefill unimplemented -> Engine::generate fallback. A path whose prefill is unimplemented is precisely a path that might not condition on the prompt.
H2_serve_path_does_not_condition.against: nothing yet; this hypothesis has not been tested.

two_hypotheses_and_the_discriminator.why_identical_output_does_not_settle_it: Rate collapse also produces a constant continuation -- the Llama-1B precedent emitted the same token repeatedly regardless of prompt. So prompt-independence is consistent with BOTH hypotheses and discriminates neither.
two_hypotheses_and_the_discriminator.the_campaign_s_own_discriminator: HAWKING_MODEL_FEEL_PARITY_RESULTS.json settled the Llama-1B case by running a numpy oracle over the same container through the same codec and showing it predicted the same collapsed distribution -- 'so this is the artifact's behaviour and not a runtime defect'. Execution correctness was proven separately: CPU max logit diff vs oracle 2.61e-05, GPU 6.68e-06, argmax and top5 exact. That is the method to apply here, and it is the only thing that will settle it.

what_this_does_to_the_odyssey_gates.G4: The wire now exists, which was the blocker. But G4 demands the live turn loop produce REAL generated tokens. Tokens that are real but prompt-independent do not obviously satisfy that, and the controller will not call G4 met until H1 and H2 are separated.
what_this_does_to_the_odyssey_gates.G5: The support-halo pre-Odyssey baseline is now mechanically runnable. It must NOT be run yet: 26 tasks scored against a possibly-degenerate substrate would produce a baseline that silently encodes the defect, and every later regression measurement would be taken against it. Running it now is the expensive mistake available here.
what_this_does_to_the_odyssey_gates.G2: unchanged, owned by the Codex Temporal Gravity lane
what_this_does_to_the_odyssey_gates.odyssey_authorization: NOT GRANTED. If H1 is true, Odyssey would train on a substrate that cannot generate, which is exactly the failure ODYSSEY_PROMOTION_GATE.md was written to prevent and which cannot be un-trained.

controller_position: This is the most consequential thing found this session and it is deliberately left unattributed rather than guessed. The substrate is sealed, verified, and byte-perfect at 282/282 shards and 59,585 frozen decisions -- and none of that was ever evidence that it can generate. Integrity and capability are different claims. The oracle discriminator is queued as its own lane.
